playbookOutputs: SARS Customs Remover of Goods in Bond licence issued via RLA
RLA approval notification and security/surety acceptance
Note on licensee obligations (vehicle list kept current, security in force, annual renewal, bonded movement records)
playbookCommonFailures: Entity has no customs client number yet (importer/exporter registration) — the remover licence is layered on an existing customs registration
Vehicle and premises details incomplete (registration numbers, ownership/lease, storage premises) so Customs raises a query
Surety/bond not lodged in SARS-prescribed form or for the amount SARS determines
No active registered representative or unverifiable cell number on the SARS profile — RLA rejects the application
Tax compliance status not in good standing at the time of submission

informationToProvide.label: Company Registration Certificate (CIPC CoR 14.3) & Certified Director IDs (< 3 Months)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload the company CoR 14.3 registration certificate and certified director ID copies (< 3 months).
informationToProvide.aiHint: Official CIPC CoR14.3 and certified director IDs (< 90 days) of the applicant transporter.

informationToProvide.label: Existing SARS Customs Client Registration Proof (Customs Client Code Letter / RLA Notice)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload proof of the company existing SARS Customs Client Number.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Proof that the entity already holds a SARS customs client number (importer/exporter or other customs registration).

informationToProvide.label: Fleet Vehicle & Trailer Registration Certificates (NaTIS RC1), Lease Agreements & Cross-Border Permits
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload the NaTIS registration certificates (and lease agreements if leased) for every mechanical horse, truck, and trailer that will carry bonded goods.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Vehicle registration papers (RC1) or leases with registration numbers, trailer details, storage premises proof, and any cross-border road transport permit.

informationToProvide.label: Proof of Physical Business & Storage Premises Address (< 3 Months) & Bank Confirmation Letter (< 3 Months)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload proof of physical business premises (< 3 months) and official company bank confirmation letter (< 3 months).
informationToProvide.aiHint: Proof of the PHYSICAL business premises and bank confirmation letter dated within 90 days in the entity name.

informationToProvide.label: Customs Remover in Bond Surety / Security Bond (Bank Guarantee or Insurance Surety Undertaking)
informationToProvide.helpText: Upload your SARS Customs Remover in Bond security guarantee or provisional insurer undertaking.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Bank guarantee or insurance surety in favour of SARS Customs showing amount and the entity name.

informationToProvide.label: Borders / Ports of Entry Operated, VAT Number & Verifiable SARS Profile Cellphone Number
informationToProvide.helpText: List the border posts / ports of entry and corridors you will operate on, your VAT number (if VAT registered), and the verifiable cellphone number on SARS Registered Details.

informationToProvide.label: SARS eFiling Username
informationToProvide.helpText: Primary eFiling username for your personal or company profile. Please ensure the username is active.

informationToProvide.label: SARS eFiling Password
informationToProvide.helpText: ⚠️ IMPORTANT: Please test your password on sarsefiling.co.za before submitting to avoid delays or account lockouts. (Stored encrypted at rest).

informationToProvide.label: SARS eFiling OTP Required? (Yes / No)
informationToProvide.helpText: Specify Yes or No (does your eFiling login trigger an SMS OTP or SARS Mobile App push notification?).
informationToProvide.aiHint: Confirmation of whether SARS eFiling login requires multi-factor authentication (OTP/App push).

informationToProvide.label: Best Time to Contact for SARS OTP
informationToProvide.helpText: Select preferred date, time slot, and direct phone number so our team can coordinate live OTP approval.
informationToProvide.conditionalQuestion: If OTP is required, when is the best time and number to contact you?
informationToProvide.aiHint: Client preferred date, time window, and contact number for live OTP coordination.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect licence application documents, vehicle and security details
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: All required uploads received; vehicle schedule, premises, routes/ports and security details captured
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Name each document and why Customs needs it. Ask for: every vehicle/trailer with registration number and whether owned or leased; storage premises; the ports/border posts and routes they will operate; whether goods will move cross-border; existing customs client number; VAT number (improves approval chances); bank/insurer for the surety. Do not promise faster than 3-5 working days for our submission — Customs approval and security take longer.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Check customs registration, registered representative, cell number and compliance status
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Customs client number exists on RLA; active registered representative; verifiable cell number on SARS Registered Details; TCS Compliant
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: On eFiling confirm: (1) an existing customs client number under Customs > RLA — if none, stop and propose the import/export licence service first; (2) registered representative active — if not, propose the Tax Representative Appointment service; (3) the cell number on the profile is verifiable (cellphone invoice, affidavit or accountant's letter) — if it differs from the client's number the RAV01 must be updated first (OTP; hand off to Kevin); (4) Tax Compliance Status Compliant. Never attempt OTP or CAPTCHA.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Verify documents and vehicle/premises schedule
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: All uploads pass the rules engine or are approved by Kevin; every vehicle on the schedule is backed by a registration paper or lease
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Entity is the transporter company. Cross-check the vehicle schedule against registration certificates/leases; flag vehicles registered to a director or third party without a lease. Premises and bank must be in the company's name. Security document must name SARS Customs.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Prepare RLA remover of goods in bond hand-off sheet
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Hand-off sheet with every RLA field value, vehicle schedule and upload list posted for Kevin
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Fields (RLA licence type 'Remover of goods in bond' — DA185 + the remover annexure, ⚠ verify annexure number): applicant details, existing customs code, tax and VAT numbers, physical premises, directors, contact person and cell, bank details, vehicle schedule (registration, make, type, owned/leased), storage premises, places of entry/exit and routes, security type and amount. Fill from verified facts only; leave unknowns blank and flag.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Submit remover of goods in bond licence application on eFiling RLA
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: RLA application staged with all documents attached; Kevin submits and the RLA reference number is recorded
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Path: eFiling > Customs > Registration Licensing and Accreditation (RLA) > New Application > Licence type 'Remover of goods in bond' (⚠ verify current menu names). Stage all values, attach: CoR14.3, certified ID of representative, customs registration proof, vehicle documents, premises proof, security document, cell-number proof. Screenshot each screen and stop for Kevin to submit. Record the reference number.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Wait for Customs assessment, security acceptance and licence issue
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Licence issued on RLA / approval notification received, or SARS security determination received and actioned
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Check the RLA dashboard at each follow-up. Customs commonly responds with the required security amount or a premises/vehicle inspection; create a proposal for Kevin and a plain client message with what is needed. Escalate via the Customs contact centre with the reference number if no movement by day 10.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver licence and obligations note
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Licence, customs code and guidance posted to Communication History
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Explain: keep the vehicle list current on RLA (add/remove vehicles), keep the surety in force, renew annually (⚠ verify renewal cycle), keep bonded movement records (SAD500/transit documents, acquittals) for 5 years, and that failing to acquit a bonded movement makes the remover liable for the duty. Offer the annual compliance and VAT services.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Final sign-off
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Kevin confirms the order can be completed
